title: Legislative activity per politician, 2019-02-01 to the collection date

definitions.scope: Bills (PL, PLP, PEC, PDL) presented in the period. Câmara: proponente = 1; main author = first signatory (ordemAssinatura 1), co-author = the other proponents (RICD art. 102). Senado: main author = first name in the 'autoria' field.
definitions.outcome: Last official status of each bill. Câmara: the situation, and for 'Arquivada' the reason written in the despacho. Senado: the deliberation code (siglaTipoDeliberacao) and the current situation.

state_deputies.reason: No uniform open source covers the 27 state assemblies.
